title: /data/v1/gauges/index.json and /data/v1/gauges/tiles/{key}.json: site eligibility for every lower-48 discharge gauge
description: The one eligibility rule (serving/src/flowcast_serve/eligibility.py), evaluated weekly. The selector loads the tiles intersecting its viewport and shows a gauge as clickable when eligibility.forecast_now is true.

rule.description: Thresholds in force and the text for each reason code

tiles.description: Tile keys and their gauge counts

name.description: USGS station name as published (sites.json has the cleaned-up name for model basins)

record_years.description: Years of daily discharge on record

status.description: model_basin: forecast on visit today. eligible: passes every criterion; forecast once on-the-fly onboarding ships (the API answers not_supported until then). ineligible: see reasons

forecast_now.description: POST /api/visit will start a forecast (status model_basin)

has_temp.description: Water temperature (00010) reported in the last 7 days; temperature is forecast only where this is true and the temperature model covers the basin
